This is the OTHER side of the contract: it is the panel's own statement of
what it ships, so the test that feeds it to scripts/assert_wall_capabilities.py
can fail. Re-baseline it only when the panel line moves on and you want the
suite to track the new head; a panel change does NOT require touching it.
